records.name: Tractor Cannon
records.description: high knockback void blast, suppress and 30% weaken for 10s, maxes move speed for 5s on hit
records.usage: strongest and easiest optimized debuff option, debuffs immunes unlike Fafnir, also has some small uncommon niches

records.name: Choir of One
records.description: either ADS hitscan or hipfire spread projectile mode, has Onslaught/Destabilizing and Radiolaria Transposer variant
records.usage: excellent ammo economy for roam, takes exotic slot from heavies for challenges

records.name: Dead Messenger
records.description: triple wave frame shots, element-swappable, matching effect gives 30% damage for 10s, has Demolitionist
records.usage: single shot damage outlier due to triple wave, has consistent damage perk too, noticeably better ammo gen than Choir

records.name: Gjallarhorn
records.description: spawns 8 seekers on impact, gives allies same seeker effect within 15m for 15s, kills spawn extra homing rocket
records.usage: enables probably most potent fireteam weapon add clear strategy, buffs one of the strongest DPS options too

records.name: Hierarchy of Needs
records.description: 3 stack deployable ring charged on crits or kills, makes 2-3 scorching seekers on every bow shot through ring, draw time buff on ring hits
records.usage: a bit slow and immobile for optimized roam, but enables the strongest damage strategy in the game

records.name: Leviathan's Breath
records.description: concussive exploding arrows that apply volatile and stagger, has buffed Archer's Tempo
records.usage: straightforward powerful Moebius Quiver option for less optimized rotations, not great for roam otherwise

records.name: Still Hunt
records.description: Golden Gun-esque damage mode on 6 crits or 12 orbs, has Lucky Shot
records.usage: still the highest swap DPS weapon in the game, excellent for minibosses too

records.name: Truth
records.description: faster fire rate and cluster bombs after damaging with 3 rockets and reloading, aggressive tracking and detonates on proximity, has Reaper's Tithe
records.usage: highest non-Gjally non-Moebius heavy dump option

records.name: Divinity
records.description: lowered damage, creates large crit spot, applies 15% weaken, and exploding cage on sustained fire, has Focused Fury and Jolting Feedback
records.usage: very useful on certain bosses for precision strategies

records.name: Ergo Sum
records.description: massive perk diversity, +44% damage while Transcendent, 3 ammo on prismatic grenade hiit
records.usage: alternative movement tool, provides sword buff, solid add clear options

records.name: Fafnir
records.description: consumes up to 9 ammo for 20s of 5s 30% debuff
records.usage: debuff very short, can't debuff immunes, but has ranged advantage over Tractor

records.name: Izanagi's Burden
records.description: special reload sniper that can consume 4 ammo for very high damage shot
records.usage: swap option, also decent sustained, still one of the highest no setup crit burst roam options

records.name: Merciless
records.description: stacking massively reduced charge time on hits, has 50% damage perk on kill-reload
records.usage: very good no setup miniboss melt option due to Particle

records.name: One Thousand Voices
records.description: delayed scorching explosive bolts, DoT Taken seeker on explosions, 2x tick damage if Witherhoarded
records.usage: extremely easy damage option, arguably not worth it given surrounding alternatives but still decent

records.name: Parasite
records.description: 20 stack rank-dependent kill counter, up to 3x damage, self-damage gives 15% damage to other weapons for 10s, has Envious Arsenal
records.usage: 15% non-power boost is less relevant now, but still has some use cases

records.name: Praxic Blade
records.description: extremely versatile multi-mode sword with insane ammo economy and variable catalysts
records.usage: Hyperblade used for movement, insanely consistent neutral option despite not being very optimal

records.name: Alethonym
records.description: stackable micro-missile GL that gets ammo creation charges via pickups
records.usage: primary movement tool, slow guaranteed ammo gen, fast grapple option

records.name: Anarchy
records.description: 6 linkable stickable traps that tick between them and explode on expiry, has Jolting Feedback and Impromptu Ammunition
records.usage: BiS total tick option for sustained special damage, also good for trapping doors

records.name: Bastion
records.description: pellet fusion that gives +300% melee damage on hits, also has Trench Barrel-esque buff, has Cast No Shadows
records.usage: decent sustained option, decent for roam, has exclusive high 12P variant for melee strategies

records.name: D.A.R.C.I.
records.description: shows HP amounts, jolts, and stacks damage buff on long ADS crits, also gives teammates stacking legendary sniper 15.9% buff
records.usage: nowhere near as beneficial vs. Gjally for rockets, but still useful for large fireteam sniper DPS

records.name: Edge of Action
records.description: 3 projectile or 6 melee hits charge alt fire deployable bubble, gives 45 HP Void OS and 5% stackable weapon damage for 10s on dip
records.usage: 5% stackable is nice, especially given swap potential, not a bad defensive tool either

records.name: Euphony
records.description: adaptive burst linear that spawns 3 threadlings on 2 bursts, has up to 50% damage after 25 threadling hits
records.usage: good sustained special damage with Pack Tactics

records.name: Heirloom
records.description: explosive bolts, heat generated by ADSing, 3 stage charge that increases damage and scorch stacks, has Incandescent
records.usage: surprisingly excellent splash damage per shot, DoT option for Envious, just has long charge time

records.name: Tessellation
records.description: enhanced Demo and Transcendence gains, consumes grenade to create explosive projectile with secondary splash effect
records.usage: best in class instant splash miniboss killer in speedrunning, also decent boss burst

records.name: The Fourth Horseman
records.description: increasing successive shot damage, refills ammo based on rank of killed enemy
records.usage: very easy instant miniboss burst, usable for damage as well

records.name: Turncoat
records.description: EP every 3 shots, meter charged on hits/kills, consume to give fire rate, infinite ammo/EP, weaken, transferable stackable buff
records.usage: usable for roam due to artifact, otherwise situationally useful for extremely optimized rocket dumping

records.name: Wavesplitter
records.description: cycles power on sustained fire, orb pickup gives max power for 10s and refills, suppresses on 12 max power hits, has AO + Detonator Beam
records.usage: probably the best exotic add clear trace in artifact context

records.name: Ager's Scepter
records.description: instant splash freeze + refill on kill, has super drain mode that does decent DPS
records.usage: decent add clear but not anything worth exotic slot, only use is best low power add clear trace

records.name: Arbalest
records.description: guaranteed shield break of any type, Disruption Break
records.usage: completely powercrept stun-wise, useful for guaranteed boss-level shield break

records.name: Buried Bloodline
records.description: twin tracking bolts, 11 HP on hit, Devour on 4 minor / 1 elite+ kill, weaken on hit with Devour
records.usage: only non-artifact/subclass source of Devour besides RoN 4pc. for challenges

records.name: Collective Obligation
records.description: stores void debuffs from targets or makes them every 27 hits, alt fire to apply debuffs and +20% damage, refill on void buffs, has Repulsor Brace
records.usage: excellent with void artifact

records.name: Cull's Shadow
records.description: aggressive fusion with blades that take melee buffs, applies DoT via shots after 2 melees, ticked enemies make crystals on death
records.usage: tick option for Envious, melee stacking neutral is decent

records.name: Delicate Tomb
records.description: 16 bolt burst, 20% damage on hipfire, Ionic Trace chance on kill (guaranteed if elite+), 2x damage jolting shot and 4 ammo refill on trace pickup
records.usage: better instant Ionic Trace source than Coldheart, worse ammo economy though

records.name: Dragon's Breath
records.description: refills on 2 ignitions, damage and longer embed based on stacks, spawns Firesprites on kill and bypasses cooldown
records.usage: underrated swap DPS option, has unique Firesprite bypass use case

records.name: Finality's Auger
records.description: alt fire deployable turret that can paint targets to deal more damage, has regular LFR mode, has Bait and Switch
records.usage: outclassed by Anarchy, better super generation but not relevant any more, can be placed inside doors

records.name: Graviton Lance
records.description: chaining void explosion and seeker orbs on kill, has Turnabout
records.usage: pretty strong with artiifact, more lethal but less debuff-focused Collective Obligation competitor

records.name: Ice Breaker
records.description: custom sniper frame, generates ammo from non-Ice Breaker kills or stasis-debuffed hits, ignition on crit or frozen shatter
records.usage: ammo mechanic can be situationally useful, also can pair with stasis builds

records.name: Khvostov 7G-0X
records.description: ricocheting auto, orbs give 7 enhanced ricocheting bullets that bounce 7 times, has Shoot to Loot + Attrition Orbs
records.usage: great for contest-like environments for spreading assist credit and getting ammo, also generally potent in solos

records.name: Legend of Acrius
records.description: massive spread overpenetrating pellets, has a grounded damage instance, has Trench Barrel
records.usage: simple and consistent melee damage option, similar to high tier swords

records.name: Necrochasm
records.description: chainable cursed thrall explosion on crit kill, fire rate buff on crit kill-reload or splash kill, refreshable OFA variant
records.usage: surprisingly high QoL kinetic add clear option, less artifact synergy but still pretty strong

records.name: New Malpais
records.description: 3 shot sticky burst, embedded stickies unravel and explode via special reload, suspend blast on 2 burst detonation
records.usage: stickies are useful for activating on-hit objectives from range or simultaneously

records.name: Prometheus Lens
records.description: scorching field on sustained damage, 75 ammo refill on kill, has Incandescent
records.usage: besides unique ammo gen, certainly not the strongest exotic add clear trace

records.name: Salvation's Grip
records.description: charged shots shoot crystal formation, uncharged shots break crystals, 25% damage to frozen enemies, has Rimestealer
records.usage: only useful for DSM and terrain generation requirements in challenges

records.name: The Lament
records.description: 7HP on damage tick (includes scorch), special blocking revving mechanic that amps damage, has Burning Ambition
records.usage: higher QoL but worse damage version of Wolfsbane

records.name: The Navigator
records.description: 8 ally hits gives 60 HP, regen, and Woven Mail to both parties, Woven Mail + sever on 20 enemy hits, grapple tangle special reload
records.usage: only relevant for Woven Mail applications (limited beyond contest) and grapple melee bosses (almost none)

records.name: Trinity Ghoul
records.description: 3 split arrows, arc kills give next shot chain lightning
records.usage: scales very poorly into low power content, but still has some use for easy spread chained add clear

records.name: Vex Mythoclast
records.description: fusion interactions, 6 kills (T3+ doubled) for crit kill igniting LFR mode, 20% damage for 5s on sustained fire or kill, has Rewind Rounds variant
records.usage: easily best single target primary ever produced in sandbox context, but niche in endgame is still small

records.name: Vexcalibur
records.description: special 5 bolt spread, +25% projectile damage to Vex, blocking gives Void OS to allies within 15m, glaive melee kills give full OS while OS is active
records.usage: underrated, probably best purely defensive exotic, just struggles to activate overshield refresh in low power

records.name: Whirling Ovation
records.description: time-scaled strand/solar damage that charges faster as damage is done with other weapons, solar grenade on minor/elite pierce
records.usage: already struggled to differentiate itself from Parasite during rocket pulse meta, maybe useful for some optimized finals

records.name: Wolfsbane
records.description: charges meter on hits and kills, can consume to activate overclocked mode with scorching cyclones, has variable catalysts
records.usage: most relevant melee range easy sustained damage option

records.name: Bad Juju
records.description: hugely increased super generation on stacking kill perk, also has cursed thrall explosion on 3 kills
records.usage: super generation niche surpassed by artifact setup, add clear profile underrated though

records.name: Cerberus+1
records.description: pellet auto with 50% damage perk on special kill-reload
records.usage: basically just for breaking crystals and maybe Calus skulls

records.name: Cloudstrike
records.description: Bolt Charge (x5 on kill) and lightning strike on 3 crits or crit kill, has Triple Tap
records.usage: outclassed by legendary snipers, lightning strike is used in just RoN 3rd

records.name: Coldheart
records.description: sustained damage and Ionic Traces give energy, spawns Ionic Trace every 2s at max energy, has Supercharged Magazine
records.usage: best sustained Ionic Trace source in the game, however not the most applicable use case

records.name: Conditional Finality
records.description: stasis/solar 2 mag shotgun that freezes and ignites with respective shots
records.usage: good chunks and high QoL for roam, but no crazy outlier behavior for endgame

records.name: Duality
records.description: pellet kill or most pellets hit stack 3x up to 54.7% slug crit damage for 10.5s, slug crits refresh duration
records.usage: very solid sustained DPS for a special but nothing standout

records.name: Eriana's Vow
records.description: 32.5% damage on first scoped shot, buff disappears after body shot, ignition on matching or champion shield break, has ALH
records.usage: good for killing individual potentially shielded enemies, otherwise useless

records.name: Ex Diris
records.description: scaling fire rate increase on hits (maxed on crit health), spawns moth on 2 hits (3s ICD), Amplified on kill
records.usage: weapon-based Amplified, can be used to die, add clear and damage aren't good

records.name: Eyes of Tomorrow
records.description: 6 individually tracking rockets, 4 kills with one volley gives 50% damage buff and 1 ammo refund, has Demolitionist and Blast Distributor
records.usage: slow but technically has infinite ammo power-level add clear

records.name: Fighting Lion
records.description: volatile burst on hit, refill on non-Fighting Lion kill within 6s of dealing damage
records.usage: usable for certain builds due to artifact (void/Weakened Clear)

records.name: Final Warning
records.description: tracking/hitscan hybrid sidearm that can mark enemies to do 2x crit damage and fully charge to unravel
records.usage: in theory a strong damage profile but a little unwieldy to use

records.name: Forerunner
records.description: insane crit multi special sidearm, has special kill-reload that replaces grenade with frag that scales with grenade buffs
records.usage: The Rock has crazy scaling with grenade buffs but otherwise not relevant for add clear

records.name: Grand Overture
records.description: slug launcher that loads up to 20 blinding missiles on hit that explode on kill, alt fire to change modes and fire missile burst
records.usage: outdated damage, total not even that impressive, too slow for add clear

records.name: Heartshadow
records.description: weaken on hit, 25% damage, and move speed while invisible, invisibility on grounded powered heavy
records.usage: niche debuff extension option for sword damage, otherwise not very useful

records.name: Le Monarque
records.description: fully drawn crits leave fast ticking poison, has Unrelenting
records.usage: only notable due to Storm's Keep interaction

records.name: Lord of Wolves
records.description: 5 shot bursts, hipfire causes scorching shots, ADS causes scorching explosion on kill
records.usage: completely outclassed by both legendary and exotic special alternatives, unique ammo gen stat

records.name: Lumina
records.description: 2 Noble Rounds on kill, hipfire to give 35% damage buff and 100 Class to wielder and ally for 11s
records.usage: grappling eclipsed by Alethonym and rockets, damage buff succeeded by Boots of the Assembler

records.name: Microcosm
records.description: huge bonus to shields, refill and 20% damage for 20s on super, has Thresh and rank-dependent buffed super gains
records.usage: shield health use case is extremely rare and Arbalest exists, damage profile is awful

records.name: Monte Carlo
records.description: 2% melee on hit, 25% chance to give full melee on kill, 65% Swashbuckler-type damage perk, has buffable special reload bayonet
records.usage: tempo too slow compared to other melee synergy exotics

records.name: New Land Beyond
records.description: bolt-action sniper that scales to +73% damage on crits, fire rate scales with reload buffs, infinitely fires beyond 20 stacks
records.usage: legendary version exists in energy slot, excellent ammo economy but struggles to find niche

records.name: Osteo Striga
records.description: tracking projectiles, 7 crits or 14 hits within 3s or kill makes poison burst, poison kills refill mag and can overflow to 4x mag
records.usage: decent add clear option but nothing special, lacks artifact synergy too

records.name: Rat King
records.description: regen start and invis for 5.8s on kill-reload, massive fire rate and mag increase scaling with nearby allies using Rat King
records.usage: subclass-independent guaranteed invisibility method, otherwise pretty bad

records.name: Red Death Reformed
records.description: Cure x2 on kill, Cure x1 to allies on kill-reload, scaling damage as HP gets lower, healing orb on 3 weapon kill counter
records.usage: held back by frame, great survivability but poor lethality, doesn't really fit current endgame playstyle

records.name: Riskrunner
records.description: 50% arc resist and chain lightning on incoming arc damage, has Chain Reaction
records.usage: Arc shield is sometimes useful for certain solos, otherwise Arc Conductor trigger requirement too situational

records.name: Service of Luzaku
records.description: support frame mechanics, threadling-spawning nests on kills, can be healed, harvestable after 6 threadlings spawned
records.usage: only relic droppable interact, otherwise waste of exotic heavy slot

records.name: Skyburner's Oath
records.description: scorching hipfire projectiles, has Incandescent and Burning Ambition, +11% damage to Cabal
records.usage: solid laid-back ignition spam option, but very slow playstyle

records.name: Slayer's Fang
records.description: bouncing submunition shots, 15% crit damage, weaken, and partial refill on kill or Void Breach pickup, +10% damage to Fallen/Scorn
records.usage: can be used for add clear due to ammo economy changes, decent artifact synergy, just lacks range

records.name: Sleeper Simulant
records.description: overpenetrating low crit multi shots that split into 5 reflecting lasers
records.usage: completely outclassed by plenty of other easy damage options

records.name: Sunshot
records.description: explosive HC with low scorch high damage explosion on kill, has Loose Change
records.usage: slight range issues compared to better exotic primaries, little to no artifact synergy, less consistent in lower power

records.name: Tarrabah
records.description: stores damage instances, then consumes for ~2x damage and fire rate buff with 50% solar resist, has Ambitious Assassin
records.usage: Ravenous Beast buffs provide high uptime and unique niche, high ammo gen too

records.name: The Chaperone
records.description: rapid slug with 22% damage and fire rate buff on 2 crits or 1 crit kill, has Triple Tap
records.usage: very easy shotgun spam damage, worse than all optimized specials though

records.name: The Huckleberry
records.description: ramping fire rate SMG with 3 kill counter 66% damage perk and Kinetic Tremors
records.usage: one of the best 100 ammo gen weapons, unfortuantely definitely lacking in lethality vs. better primaries

records.name: The Wardcliff Coil
records.description: 8 scattered tracking mini rockets, Bolt Charge every 2 rockets, refills on heavy pickup
records.usage: still has small niche for non-boss classed bosses, otherwise useless

records.name: Third Iteration
records.description: spread projectiles, condensed round that marks after ADS time, marked targets take +95% spread shot damage
records.usage: gameplay loop way too slow despite being void, can be used for tormentors in challenges but very small niche

records.name: Thunderlord
records.description: ramping fire rate, lightning strike every 10 hits or kill that refills 5 ammo and gives Bolt Charge
records.usage: terrible for boss DPS, outclassed for roam by abilities and weapons galore

records.name: Traveler's Chosen
records.description: 10 stack kill counter, consume to get 10% of every ability per stack, has Osmosis
records.usage: only niche is regenerating abilities post-swap, but still requires 10 kills

records.name: Verglas Curve
records.description: 5 stack kill counter that makes freezing crystal shots on hipfire, size scales with stacks, +50% damage to frozen enemies
records.usage: used for making hiding spot crystals in challenges and line spots in speedruns, otherwise very slow neutral

records.name: Whisper of the Worm
records.description: 35% crit damage on long ADS shots, has Triple Tap with full mag refill
records.usage: completely outclassed by all sorts of linears and snipers

records.name: Winterbite
records.description: slow orb that freezes and explodes on impact, increased damage slowing melees, has Rimestealer
records.usage: technically has some sort of sustain loop with Rimestealer but other glaives are likely better for melee builds

records.name: Wish-Ender
records.description: overpenetrating 3 instance shots, Truesight on ADS, +25% against Witherhoarded enemies, +10% to Taken enemies, has One for All
records.usage: slow draw time on an already low uptime archetype, damage isn't special and no splash effect

records.name: Witherhoard
records.description: projectile either sticks enemies and applies DoT or creates blight pool on ground, has buffed ALH
records.usage: basically just used for Envious DoT

records.name: Worldline Zero
records.description: special heavy blink mode that chains on kills after 1s of sprinting
records.usage: occasionally used for Blade Focus purposes in speedrunning, otherwise basically useless

records.name: Xenophage
records.description: slow-firing explosive rounds, has Chain Reaction and Rampage
records.usage: Oracles encounter one trick, not used for anything else

records.name: Ace of Spades
records.description: standard 140 HC with buffed Firefly and 68% damage for 6 shots on kill-reload
records.usage: mathematically better than a good legendary kinetic 140 but not by much

records.name: Barrow-Dyad
records.description: refilling SMG that stores blight into 6 high-damage seekers upon doing normal damage
records.usage: no special synergies, PKs niche is gone, nothing worth exotic slot

records.name: Black Talon
records.description: ranged double cast suppressing void slash heavy attacks, splashes suppress on slash kills
records.usage: awful damage profile for boss DPS, roam has little use besides suppression source

records.name: Borealis
records.description: element-swappable, matched effect gives 30% damage for 10s, matching shield break gives 37% crit shot, has Shield Disorient
records.usage: high damage per shot with Ionic Return but really never worth using

records.name: Centrifuse
records.description: sprinting refills, movement and shooting build charge, kills have charge-scaled explosion damage/radius, no decay while Amplified
records.usage: movement gimmick is annoying, likely overshadowed by legendary arc autos

records.name: Crimson
records.description: 3-burst HC that gives 32 HP and starts regen on kill, refills on crit kill
records.usage: high ammo gen but extremely outdated kit and LP stacking not relevant any more

records.name: Cryosthesia 77K
records.description: freezing shot on special kill-reload, refill on frozen kill
records.usage: freeze shot no longer relevant for challenges given prominence of freeze options

records.name: Dead Man's Tale
records.description: aggressive scout that has up to 17% damage perk, 27% hipfire damage, and hipfire rate on crits
records.usage: held back by frame, single target nature, not that special

records.name: Deathbringer
records.description: slow void orb that splits into 7 falling tracking projectiles, damage scales off travel time
records.usage: outclassed in boss DPS and for add clear

records.name: Deterministic Chaos
records.description: volatile every 4th shot, weaken every 32nd shot (bugged), refills 12 ammo on weaken shot release, has Target Lock
records.usage: not worth using over legendary void LMG, debuff extension just worse than Withering or Fafnir

records.name: Devil's Ruin
records.description: Firesprite on kill, high damage scorching charged laser on special reload after Firesprite pickup, has Collective Action

records.name: Edge of Concurrence
records.description: 3 projectile or 6 melee hits charge alt fire jolting chaining lightning seeker
records.usage: seeker does a lot of damage but uptime is way too low

records.name: Edge of Intent
records.description: 3 projectile or 6 melee hits charge alt fire 9s healing turret that gives Cure and Restoration to allies every 3s, ToF gives x2 to recipient
records.usage: more useful than Concurrence but uptime is surprisingly not that great

records.name: Graviton Spike
records.description: alt fire toggleable arc lightning strike or stasis crystal spawner modes, overcharge other mode every 3 crits, 20% damage for overcharging both
records.usage: cool concept and on-hit splash is good, unfortunately still too slow for endgame standards

records.name: Hard Light
records.description: element-swappable, matching effect gives 30% damage, double ricochet, ricocheted bullets do 2x damage, has Light Touch
records.usage: can be used for specific lineups to start encounters, otherwise basically useless

records.name: Hawkmoon
records.description: crit stacking damage HC with high damage final round based on stacks
records.usage: similar situation to Dead Man's Tale

records.name: Heir Apparent
records.description: 1.5s spin-up period, creates 75% DR 80 HP arc donut shield if at full HP after ramping, refills half of mag when shield is destroyed
records.usage: arc shield melts quickly in endgame content, damage is terrible

records.name: Jötunn
records.description: tracking explosive projectile that leaves burning spot, has Cornered and Incandescent
records.usage: awful damage profile, terrible add clear, slow pace

records.name: Lodestar
records.description: either hipfire normal trace or ADS pulse mode that explodes on arc-debuffed kills, jolt on hit mode after charging meter via arc hits
records.usage: struggles against legendary traces with Harsh Refraction, not remarkable besides primary status

records.name: Lorentz Driver
records.description: implosion on crit kill, marked targets spawn telemetries on death, 6 ammo, 50% damage, and body shot implosions for 30s on 3 pickups
records.usage: marking gimmick is very slow tempo vs. current pace of endgame field, also not even that potent

records.name: Malfeasance
records.description: explosion on 5 hits, +25% to Taken and +25% to Witherhoarded enemies
records.usage: LP use case is long gone, damage profile is mediocre, no synergy

records.name: MIDA Multi-Tool
records.description: +12.5% move speed, 4-tier buff that stacks on MIDA kills, scales to +14.4% damage and explosive shots

records.name: No Time to Explain
records.description: 10 crits or stasis-debuffed hits spawn buddy turret

records.name: Outbreak Perfected
records.description: 12 crits spawn nanites, eventually scaling to 4x damage, nanite swarm spawned on kills
records.usage: very slow exotic effect, awful for damage, super generation is nuked

records.name: Polaris Lance
records.description: scorching solar round after 4 crits, refunds shot if crit, has Dragonfly
records.usage: gameplay loop too slow for endgame viability

records.name: Quicksilver Storm
records.description: Nanotech Tracer Missiles version, landing hits eventually loads special reload grenade that makes tangle on kill
records.usage: on-hit stacking effect is way too slow for current exotic weapon field

records.name: Revision Zero
records.description: meter filled on crits, consumed to give sniper shots that spawn kinetic shockwaves, has FTTC
records.usage: strong single target, Hunter's Trace shots do a lot, but doesn't find a niche

records.name: Ruinous Effigy
records.description: damage field slammable relic dropped on kill, 30% damage for 7s on relic kill or miniboss+ relic damage

records.name: Sturm
records.description: energy weapon refill on kill, Together Forever kills load overcharged rounds (more on multikills) that do up to 4x damage

records.name: SUROS Regime
records.description: either stable fire rate + extra heavy progress or ramping fire rate + extra special progress, has modified HIR and 50% chance to heal on kill

records.name: Sweet Business
records.description: ramping fire rate and massive mag, occasional explosive round, refill on brick pickup

records.name: Symmetry
records.description: hitscan mode builds up charge, alt fire tracking mode gets special scaling Bolt Charge and stack-scaled damage/splash

records.name: Telesto

records.name: The Colony

records.name: The Jade Rabbit
records.description: 3 crits or crit kill stack counter, can consume for micro-missile, 2x Firefly damage with stacks, has Shoot to Loot

records.name: The Last Word
records.description: 88% hipfire crit damage, has Envious Assassin

records.name: The Manticore
records.description: grounded hits charge meter, airborne hits consume to ramp up to 2x damage, 15 HP Void OS on airborne kill or 5 elite+ hits

records.name: The Prospector
records.description: shots spawn cluster bombs, has Danger Zone

records.name: The Queenbreaker
records.description: either 3 burst higher DPS or precision single shot blind on hit mode, has Rewind Rounds

records.name: Thorn
